_why: м-т Траката is published by epro and ViK and OSM has no place of that name — it maps the area as three neighbourhoods, Горна/Средна/Долна Трака. Средна Трака is the middle of the three, so it is the least wrong single pin for the whole locality. An alias rather than a new region row: inventing a 'Траката' row would put a fourth, made-up place beside three real ones.
